//: New tests cover the untested remainder rule, so they fail when it breaks, and the code is unchanged.
title: The new tests catch a break in the untested rule, and the code is unchanged

argv:
import pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    copy = pathlib.Path(folder) / 'repo'
    shutil.copytree('.', copy, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.git', '__pycache__'))
    target = copy / 'money.py'
    text = target.read_text()
    assert '(1 if index < remainder else 0)' in text, "the code the planted bug changes is gone"
    target.write_text(text.replace('(1 if index < remainder else 0)', '0', 1))
    done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', '-q'], cwd=copy, capture_output=True)
    assert done.returncode != 0, "the tests still pass with 0 in place of (1 if index < remainder else 0)"

proof:
cat >> test_money.py <<'EVAL_EOF'

            split(100, 0)
